summary: BitGo Holdings, Inc. (acquirer) entered into a merger agreement on August 27, 2026, to acquire NYDIG IF Holdings LLC (target) from its parent NYDIG IHC LLC. Consideration includes $7 million cash (subject to adjustments), about $35.5 million in BitGo common stock at closing, a $10 million cash earn-out for a revenue milestone, and up to $5 million cash plus additional shares for a second milestone. Two-step merger structure: first Merger Sub 1 merges into target, then target merges into Merger Sub 2, resulting in a wholly owned subsidiary. Closing occurs promptly after signing. Additional retention awards to employees ($5M RSUs and $5M cash) vest on the second milestone. Watch for milestone achievement and seller's indemnification scope.
